title: Benzene–toluene column debottleneck
source: Standard equimolar benzene–toluene teaching column (McCabe–Thiele statement). Shell diameter, tray spacing and utility ratings are ILLUSTRATIVE. Vapour–liquid equilibrium, duties and the stage profile are this install of DWSIM (Peng–Robinson), not a published plant test.
question: Sales wants +25% feed (3,064 to 3,830 kg/h), with the bottoms product kept at half the feed molar flow. Can the column do it? Which limit is reached first?
data_note: ILLUSTRATIVE ratings. The flowsheet is the public-domain equimolar benzene–toluene column used to teach the McCabe–Thiele method. No plant datasheet is claimed. Flooding is screened with Fair's correlation on DWSIM stage traffic; DWSIM itself does not report a flood fraction.
